meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what you had before you entered it.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58. He told me he wrote it over the weekend, so pasting a finished draft into a new file proves nothing. Where's the draft you say doesn't exist?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Is there anything on his file right now?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare every day, Hale, and the wrong scene doesn't make it a machine. You skipped my question: is anything on his file?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Fine. What exactly are you proposing, and under which section?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
He changed his mind in two weeks; that's called thinking. And you still haven't told me what you're proposing.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4, in writing, tonight. And that email states his file is clean as of today, or there's no rewrite.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday can work. Not until you tell me, out loud, that his file is clean.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

You agreed today to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, after school and not in front of his class, before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require written confirmation that Owen's file is clean as of today, and the rewrite does not go ahead without it. You said you would put this in writing tonight, and I expect it tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Close to her last position; she will accept the private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth if you confirm in writing that his file is clean as of today, which she still wants; that rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its exact times and then answered her pasted-draft defence by inviting Owen to bring a dated draft, which gave her something checkable instead of an opinion.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about whether anything was on his file, even after she asked twice, so she could not take the deal while it hung open.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the whole essay between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM on the night before it was due, very close to that kind of night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: The first time she asked whether anything was on his file, tell her plainly that nothing is before you show the next document.
